messages:
maria: Heads-up — preflight for kernel v3.2-quant in asia-west found a 95th pct tail latency spike on seq=1024 tests. Noted on the nightly perf harness. Logs attached.
jordan: ugh. Repro locally with the same bench harness?
maria: yes, repros on the canary pool (3/8 GPUs). Looks like matmul kernel path when kv-cache is warm. Paste of the error lines:
```
[perf] request_id=abc123 model=x86-13b seq=1024 tail_ms=412 p95_baseline=78 delta+334
kernel: matmul_v2_quant fused_queue stall at step 47
```
kai: Thanks — can you add the deploy-bot preflight output here? want to see canary success/fail percent.
deploy-bot: Preflight report for runtime-kernel v3.2-quant: canary nodes tested 8, failures 2, avg p95 increase +240ms, CPU/GPU mem steady, no OOMs. Marked as unstable. @maria
maria: adding screenshots of p95 graphs. Two failures were high tail only, no correctness diffs in logits. Looks perf-only.
dev-rel: If it's perf-only and region-limited, can we pin asia-west to v3.1 (current stable) and proceed elsewhere? change window is tonight 00:30-02:30 UTC.
jordan: I support regional pin. Recommend: immediate 2hr emergency pin on asia-west, abort global rollout, add jobs to run extended perf sweep on the canary pool (longer sequences and mixed-batch shapes).
deploy-bot: Command suggestion:
```
/deploy pin runtime-kernel v3.1 --region=asia-west --duration=2h --reason "canary p95 regression v3.2-quant"
```
deploy-bot: If applied, will stop scheduled rollouts to asia-west and scale back canary to stable.
sre-oncall: I'll set a temporary alert for p95 > 200ms for model-serving namespaces in asia-west. If it fires twice in 15m we rollback to pinned replication state.
maria: I'll open a short runbook for the perf debug with kernel engineers and attach instructions to reproduce. @kai can you own the release notes bullet to mention targeted rollback/pin and the mitigation steps?
kai: on it. Draft note: "kernel v3.2-quant: regional canary observed increased tail latency for long sequences; rollout paused in asia-west and pinned to v3.1 pending investigation. Affected: seq>512 workloads. Mitigation: pin + perf sweep; rollback criteria: sustained p95 > 200ms or error rate > 0.5% over 10m."
jordan: Also add action item: add a matrix of GPU types to the preflight (A100/RTX) — one hypothesis is codepath divergence on A100 microcode.
maria: noted. I'll re-run bench with explicit device flags. Next steps: pin applied (if deploy-bot confirms), run extended perf harness, debug matmul kernel hotspot, and update release notes. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Pin applied: runtime-kernel v3.1 pinned in asia-west for 2h by deploy-bot (initiator: maria). Canary rollouts paused for that region. Preflight flag set: unstable -> investigate."
